description: Header file defining classes and structures for managing varyings and register packing in graphics shader compilation, including VaryingPacking class, PackedVarying, and related enums and methods.

classes.name: PackedVarying
classes.description: Represents a shader varying with associated metadata such as name, interpolation, and struct/array info.

classes.name: PackedVaryingRegister
classes.description: Represents a register assignment for a packed varying, including position and index info.

classes.name: VaryingPacking
classes.description: Manages packing of varyings into registers, including algorithms for different packing modes.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: Represents a register with occupancy flags for four components.

methods.name: VaryingPacking
methods.description: Constructor initializing packing with maximum vectors and packing mode.

methods.name: packUserVaryings
methods.description: Packs user-defined varyings into registers, logging issues.

methods.name: collectAndPackUserVaryings
methods.description: Collects and packs varyings based on merged varyings and transform feedback varyings.

methods.name: packVarying
methods.description: Attempts to pack a single varying into registers.

methods.name: isFree
methods.description: Checks if a register position is free for packing.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a varying into a register at specified position.
